messages:
Maria: Quick proposal — for the benchmark launch I think we should lead with a compact two-panel viz.
Panel A: throughput (tokens/sec) vs $ per 1k tokens (log scale for cost).
Panel B: p99 latency vs throughput with shaded bands for fallback tiers (hosted/dedicated/private).

Jon: +1. Love the two-panel idea. For cost axis can we use $/1k tokens on a log scale and annotate real examples (short convo, long chat)? :+1:

Eva: Need numbers from infra/bench team. Can we use these model examples: redwood-3b-8k-q4, redwood-7b-32k-q4, and an open 7b baseline? Also include batching/caching deltas.

Kevin: Ops ask — add a small callout box showing typical unit-economics improvement from batching+prefix cache: e.g. "up to 4x token cost reduction" with a tiny waterfall.

Maria: Agreed. Also headline copy options:
- Option A: "Serve high-quality LLM features at 1/4 the unit cost — with predictable latency."
- Option B: "Lower token costs, keep apps snappy: latency-aware routing + caching." 
Which feels more product-forward?

Jon: Option B feels less braggy, more practical. For social we can use a shorter hook: "Cut token costs, keep users fast. See how." 

Eva: Webinar idea: 15m talk + 20m live demo. Demo route:
1) Show identical prompt served on hosted -> measure p99 & cost
2) Show same prompt with dedicated + caching -> show throughput and cost waterfall
3) Q&A + next-step CTA (try hosted free credits or book Dedicated consult)

Kevin: Routing/SDR note — add an inbound tag for "bench-demo-interest" when someone clicks the chart CTA. Webhook to sales CRM with model & requested SLA.

Maria: Tasks & owners:
- Viz mock (Jon) — due Tue EOD
- Copy variants (Maria + Jon) — Wed AM
- Bench numbers (Eva + infra) — Wed noon
- Webinar flow & assets (Eva) — Thu
- Inbound routing spec (Kevin) — Thu EOD

launch-bot: Reminder: assets deadline approaching in 72h. :calendar:

Jon: Quick spec for viz (so designers have something):
```
Panel A: x=throughput (tokens/sec), y=$/1k tokens (log), points per model, color by deployment type
Panel B: x=throughput, y=p99 latency (ms), shaded bands = fallbacks (hosted/dedicated/private)
Annotations: caching uplift callout, short CTA link (https://redwood.ai/bench)
```

Maria: Great — I'll sync with design after Jon's mock. Keep captions short; we need this to work on a 1:1 social card and a 16:9 slide.

Kevin: Also, let's capture a tiny table for the press release: median cost per 1k + p99 at 1k req/s for each model. That'll help reporters.

Eva: Copy note — avoid absolute "X% cheaper" claims unless infra can back them with reproducible runs. Use "up to" where necessary.

Maria: Ok team — follow the task list. I'll run a short review on Wed 3pm PT. :rocket:
